title: First-run Hosted API visuals and getting-started screenshots
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Produce a cohesive set of high-fidelity screenshots and annotated assets for the Hosted API getting-started guide. Focus areas: model selection UX, request builder interactions, three code snippet variants (curl, Python, Node), streaming toggle behavior, environment variable and API-key copy affordances, and the small inline success state when a request returns. Deliverables will be used in docs site, onboarding email, and in-console quickstart panel.
acceptance_criteria: Hi-fi screenshots exported at 2x for docs and 1x for in-console use
Annotated assets (callouts) for each screen describing interaction and accessibility considerations
Code snippet variants present and validated with engineering for correctness against current SDKs
Design tokens and spacing match Console style guide and exported to shared Figma file
Assets added to docs PR and referenced in the onboarding snippet in the Console UI
tasks: Create wireframes for model select + request builder flow
Produce hi-fi mocks in Figma for three primary states: empty, filled request, streaming response
Add callouts and accessibility notes on keyboard focus and copy actions
Export PNG and SVG assets at required sizes and upload to Drive
Open docs PR that swaps placeholders with final screenshots
Gather engineering sign-off on code snippets and environment variable wording
screenshots_needed: Model select modal with search and recommended model groupings (showing dropdown with 'redwood-mini', 'redwood-std', 'community-llama7b')
Request builder empty state with CTA and ‘Try with sample prompt’ button
Request builder filled state showing controls: max_tokens, temperature, streaming toggle, function call dropdown
Streaming response state with incremental lines and cancel action highlighted
Copy API key and env var helper tooltip (masked key to reveal)
Three code snippets side-by-side: curl, Python (requests or SDK), Node (fetch/SDK) with proper language highlighting
Success toast / sample response rendering with truncated token/usage info
